zchunk_max_size.description: Maximum size in bytes for a zchunk. If 0, size is dynamic limited only by heap. Corresponds to zchunk_resize/max_size logic.

zchunk_default_init_size.description: Initial allocation size for empty chunks created with zchunk_new(NULL, size). Corresponds to zchunk_new.

zchunk_draft_enabled.description: Whether to enable draft methods like zchunk_frommem and zchunk_packx. Corresponds to CZMQ_BUILD_DRAFT_API.

zchunk_debug_options.description: List of debug/dumping configuration flags used in application code interacting with zchunk. Flat map of name/value pairs rendered as defines.
